claims.statement: Sony US18650VTC3 is documented as a flat-top, unprotected 18650 cell; the specification records approximately 18.2 mm x 65.0 mm and common retail references show a green wrapper for this model.
Steam Engine preserves Sony US18650VTC3 1600mAh 30A as a 1600mAh preset with a 30A runtime rating.
The Murata SDS for Sony US18650VTC3 describes a lithium-ion cell with nickel-cobalt oxide and lithium-manganese oxide cathode materials.
The exact catalog entry Sony US18650VTC3 has reliable market-introduction evidence dated 2018-01-18 or earlier.

authenticity.summary: No entry-specific authenticity assessment was established in this catalog pass; exact wrapper, batch, or pack provenance remains unresolved.
